# FRESH IRSS Demo

> Agent-facing index for the FRESH × IRSS + Silva21 public integration demo. Read the linked pages before changing the project.

## Start here

- [Home](index.html): what the demo is, what it contains, and what it does not claim.
- [The public demo](demo.html): the eight lanes, the TFL 6 map, and the synthetic climate sample.
- [Evidence and boundaries](evidence.html): sources, status vocabulary, and limits.
- [Assistant contract](assistant.html): why the drawer is disabled and what a safe backend needs.
- [Development and verification](development.html): local run, checks, and Pages deployment.
- [API reference](api/index.html): the workflow validator and dashboard functions.
